name: Apps.Deals Black Friday
accepts: Mac apps only. 'It must install and run on macOS.' Native and Electron apps are fine; websites, web apps and browser extensions are not. Mac App Store apps with in-app purchases are listed.
cost_note: Free $0 one-time submission, 'reviewed in due course; no timeline is guaranteed'. Expedited review $10 (within 24 hours), Standard feature $49 per month, Premium $169 (20 Nov 2026).
how_to_submit: Form at https://apps.deals/submit. No login and no payment step on the free route. A share link for the deal is given right after submitting; the deal appears on the list page after review.
entry_format: Fields: app name (30 characters), description (250), app icon upload, category (App Store categories), App Store link, website link, offer type (Free, Discount, Black Friday Deal, Promo Codes), pricing model (One-time or Subscription), original price, offer price, start and end date, a 'Mac app or Safari extension' checkbox, email.
rules: There is no field for a coupon code.
Prices for paid tiers rise closer to Black Friday, per the feature page.
status_note: 2026 page live with about 45 deals and a load-more button on 20 Nov 2026.
